metadata.description: CJ's skills and mods for Claude Code: planning in any tracker, a decision log, proving work in the real app, and guards for secrets, memory and Linear writes.

plugins.name: cj-stack
plugins.description: vision, shape and tickets for top-down planning in any tracker, grill, project-knowledge and hone; break-it, ui-polish, feature-files, playbooks and interrogate for proving the work; /commit and /create-pr for the terminal.

plugins.name: cj-jira
plugins.description: Archived Jira-era skills: jira-ticket, draft-ticket, github-issue and project-wiki. Install only for a Jira client.

plugins.name: cj-paint
plugins.description: painting-craft: drawing and painting scenes, figures and vehicles in code (SVG, canvas, numpy, Blender) with a screenshot review loop.

plugins.name: cj-lab
plugins.description: In-progress skills, not yet shipped in cj-stack: bug-hunt, self-verify, recall, triage, why and principles. Expect changes.

plugins.name: linear-gate
plugins.description: Holds every Linear write until you allow it.

plugins.name: usage-pace
plugins.description: Weekly usage in the status line, and whether it lasts until the reset.

plugins.name: session-modes
plugins.description: /mode readonly, research or edit, enforced for the rest of the session.

plugins.name: loop-brake
plugins.description: Ends a turn after N forced Stop-hook continuations, so a goal hook can't burn your usage.

plugins.name: hone-nudge
plugins.description: Suggests /hone <skill> when you corrected Claude during a cj-stack skill run.

plugins.name: memory-lint
plugins.description: Denies an auto-memory write that holds task state, one-off references or repo detail.

plugins.name: work-folder
plugins.description: Denies a new agent working file (plan, evidence, prototype, scratch, report, probe test) outside .claude/work/, which is gitignored, with a per-repo allow list.

plugins.name: kill-guard
plugins.description: Denies a Bash command that stops processes by name or by port, because it can also stop another checkout's dev server; a kill of a named PID passes.

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Denies a Bash git command that loses work: git branch -D, a force push to main or master, and git checkout -- . or git restore . on a dirty tree; each deny names the safe alternative.
